title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 9 Part 1, FOR-Gardening - EB.9
text: I hope you will not think me various, when I Farmace. explain to you mother experiment, which appears to me to be of considerable importance to all manufactures of oiltime.
